spec.vuln_cue: says they can't afford this, they've got nothing left until payday

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Priya speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Ewan MacLeod. I need to update my address, please.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. Before I look at your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. And what’s the first line of the address we currently have for you?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s verified. What’s your new address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can help with that. I can see there’s also a card payment due on the 28th. Is that something you wanted to talk about?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, I can’t afford this. I’ve got nothing left until payday on the 30th.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry, Ewan—that sounds really difficult. I can put you in touch with our Financial Support team, who can talk through options, or we can discuss whether extra time might be appropriate. I can’t promise what they’ll be able to offer.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, I’d like to hear about extra time. I’m not unhappy with the bank, I’m just short until payday.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s understood. I’ll note that you’re asking about extra time, but I can’t guarantee an outcome. I’ve updated your address to 42 Hill Street, Perth, PH1 2AB.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, your address is updated, and we can explore extra time for the payment, with no outcome guaranteed. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Thanks for being patient.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Ewan. Is there anything else I can help with today?
